fusions.name: Trampling Drove
fusions.desc: The drove deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Cud and Crop
fusions.desc: Sends grazing locusts into the first enemy they meet for 4 damage. 30% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Common Grazing
fusions.desc: Lays out a pasture within 4 tiles of where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it. The effect grows 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Placid Appetite
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
